title: Ambrosial Thai Tofu Curry
description: A creamy, fragrant one-pot tofu curry that balances sweet, sour, and umami flavors, perfect for a quick shojin-friendly meal.
instructions: Press the tofu for 15 minutes and cut into bite-size cubes.
Heat the vegetable oil in the kazan cauldron over medium heat and brown the tofu cubes until golden.
Add the ginger garlic paste and Thai red curry paste to the pot and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and gently stir to combine with the spices.
Add the sliced mushrooms and pour in the soy sauce, then bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Let the curry cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms are tender and the sauce thickens.
Squeeze in lime juice and sweeten with palm sugar, adjusting to taste.
Turn off the heat and stir in the chopped cilantro for freshness and color.
Serve the curry hot over steamed jasmine rice or enjoy it on its own.
Wash and dry the pot at the end for future use.
